input_format: sequence of one-byte name length, one-byte value length, name bytes, value bytes
configuration_profile: real nginx HTTP/2 header validation and pseudo-header parsers with a fresh minimal synthetic request and live stream
justification: NGX-IF15 decodes HPACK blocks but has no request stream, so it cannot reach pseudo-header semantics. This target isolates method, scheme, path, duplicate, and unknown pseudo-header handling.
state: Each input is interpreted as an ordered sequence of pseudo-header fields and passed through ngx_http_v2_validate_header and ngx_http_v2_pseudo_header using one synthetic request/stream. Request execution and authority-based virtual-server selection are not entered.
known_limitations: The adapter constructs decoded fields directly; HPACK encoding/decoding remains covered by NGX-IF10 and NGX-IF15.
:authority is excluded because it requires initialized virtual-server name hashes.
Path values capable of triggering request finalization are excluded; ordinary URI parsing, empty/duplicate paths, and safe path characters remain in scope.
The hook ends before ngx_http_v2_run_request and does not run routing or application phases.

scopes.contract: Validate and interpret ordered HTTP/2 pseudo-header fields while preserving duplicate detection and request-local state.
scopes.preconditions: A fresh pool, initialized nginx modules, core server conf with merge_slashes enabled, and a synthetic request attached to one stream.
